sentences.back_translation: Leo wheeled his blue bicycle out of the garage to prepare for an afternoon trip.
Before setting off, he put on his helmet and fastened it securely, because he realized safety is always the most important thing every time you ride.
He pedaled off and began riding toward the neighborhood park, the afternoon sun casting long shadows on the sidewalks of the block.
Taking this familiar route required paying attention to steering, especially near busy intersections where vehicles often pass.
Leo signaled his turn clearly and stopped before the crosswalk to make sure the road was completely clear.
After crossing the road safely, he sped down the gentle slope leading to the park entrance.
Upon arriving, he parked his bicycle near the big oak tree and locked the frame firmly.
The park was full of the lively sounds of children laughing and playing on the swings.
Leo took a deep breath of fresh air, glad he had come on two wheels, and then walked over to play with his friends on the grass.
